title: Warm Cheesy Mexican Potato Tacos
description: A kid-friendly Mexican dish featuring potato buns, a blend of cheeses, and a hint of mustard, all wrapped in a warm and crispy taco shell, finished with a drizzle of coconut cream crack sauce for a Mediterranean twist.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Toast the potato buns by baking them in the oven for 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, mix together the mashed potatoes, shredded cheese, mild mustard, and taco seasoning until well combined.
Spoon the potato and cheese mixture onto the toasted potato buns.
Drizzle the coconut cream over the top of the potato and cheese mixture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Drizzle the olive oil over the tacos.
Serve the tacos warm and enjoy.
Optional: top with additional shredded cheese, diced tomatoes, or sour cream.
